Creates a new code generator CLI project

## Synopsis

```bash
create-code-cli [--diagnostics] [--fail-fast] [--framework <string>] [--local-source-root <string>] [--name <string>] [--output <string>] [--slnx] [--verbose]
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`install`](/cli/install/) | Installs a Claude skill for CodeGenerator |
| [`scaffold`](/cli/scaffold/) | Scaffold a project from a YAML configuration file |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--diagnostics` | flag | `false` | no | Show environment info and per-step timing **See KL-007.** |
| `--fail-fast` | flag | `false` | no | Abort on first strategy failure |
| `-f, --framework` | string | `net9.0` | no | The target framework (e.g. net8.0, net9.0) |
| `--local-source-root` | string | — | no | Optional path to the local CodeGenerator src directory for project references |
| `-n, --name` | string | — | no | The name of the solution to create |
| `-o, --output` | string | `current directory` | no | The output directory (defaults to current directory) |
| `--slnx` | flag | `false` | no | Use .slnx (XML-based) solution format instead of .sln |
| `-v, --verbose` | flag | `false` | no | Show detailed error output and stack traces |

:::caution[Known limitation]
**`--diagnostics` prints nothing when generation fails.** On the root command, the report is rendered after the error-handling block, so a failure skips it. Timings are collected and discarded.

Combine with `--verbose` to see the failure detail. Timings for a failing step are available only by re-running the command against a case that succeeds.

_Tracked as [KL-007](/reference/known-limitations/#kl-007) · Applies to CLI 1.2.1_
:::
